name: lecture-notes
description: Turn lecture slides and transcripts into complete living notes that can be refined over time.

interface.longDescription: Create complete, readable Master Notes from lecture slides and transcripts, then keep improving the same note through questions, targeted rewrites, coverage checks, and Google Docs comments.
capabilities: Create notes from slides and lecture transcripts
Preserve formulas, proofs, examples, and instructor additions
Refine a Master Note without appending duplicate explanations
Work with Google Docs when a connected Docs tool is available
defaultPrompt: Use my slides and transcript to create a complete, readable Master Note.
Check this lecture note against the slides and transcript for missing knowledge points.
Process my unresolved Google Docs comments for this lecture note.
